description: This file contains performance test cases for event-sourced counters grain, comparing different synchronization and reentrancy strategies using the Xunit testing framework. It defines a test class with multiple test methods for warmup and performance measurement, and includes custom attributes and test case ordering logic.

classes.name: CountersGrainTests
classes.description: A test class for performance testing of event-sourced counters grain with different configurations.

classes.name: RunThisFirstAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute to mark test methods that should run first in the test execution order.

classes.name: SimplePriorityOrderer
classes.description: A custom test case orderer that prioritizes test methods marked with RunThisFirst attribute.
